title: IS17_inheritance1_2

lines.explanation: This declares a class with the name Person
This is an instance field with type String and variable name name.
This declares a method that returns nothing, is named setName and has one parameter, a String with variable name n.
This assigns n to the instance field name.
This declares a method that returns a String and is named getName
This returns the instance field name.
This declares a class named Student that extends the parent class Person.
This is an instance field with type String named stuNam.
This declares a method that returns nothing, is named setStuNum and has one parameter, a String sn.
This assigns sn to the instance field stuNam.
This declares a method that returns a String and is named getStuNum
This returns the instance field stuNam
This declares a class named TestInheritance
This is the main method of the class which means it is probably a tester or driver class.
This creates a new Student object named stu.
This calls the method setName for the object stu and assigns "Sharon Hsiao" to the name field of the stu object.
This calls the method setStuNum for the object stu and assigns 12345 to the stuNum field of the stu object.
This prints to the console the following: Student Name: Sharon Hsiao
This prints to the console the following: Student Number: 12345
There were no comments so I feel my annotation was good for this example.
